messages:
Alice M: Heads up — GHAS Trivy job is flapping on infra/runner-config. Alerts show up, then vanish on re-run. Noticed after the runner node images were bumped this morning.
Ben J: Can you paste the GHAS job id and a sample failing output? Trying to see if it's parser-related or actual vuln noise.
Alice M: job id 2026-03-19_ghas_3321. Here's the snippet that toggled: 
```
Findings:
  - CVE-2024-9999: high - path: /vendor/foo
  - CVE-2025-1111: medium - path: /vendor/bar
```
(re-run 1 minute later)
devsec-bot: GHAS scan 2026-03-19_ghas_3321 completed. 2 findings. https://ghas.company/scan/2026-03-19_ghas_3321 :white_check_mark:
Charlie K: That output looks like Trivy DB mismatch. We recently rotated the trivy DB mirror; some runners still use old DB cache. SRE Oncall: We saw a flaky cache purge on the runners during the node-image rollout — evictions + racing download. Might be the same root cause.
Ben J: If it's DB mismatch then suppression rules could be wrong too. Alice, do the disappearing alerts correspond to suppressed IDs?
Alice M: Yes, one of them was an existing suppression rule that got auto-applied by the suppression-sync job, then later the rule didn't match after the vuln metadata changed, so GHAS treated it as new again.
Eve: That's bad — we can't have suppression rules silently toggling. We need an audit trail and an approval gate for suppression merges.
Charlie K: Agreed. Proposed short fix: pin trivy DB version on the scanner pod and add a backoff + retry on DB update so runners don't see partial state. Also add a suppression-rule validation step in the pipeline that rejects rules with no owner.
Ben J: Can we mitigate now? Options: rollback the node image, force re-sync DB to all runners, or temporarily disable auto-apply of suppression rules.
SRE Oncall: I can kick a forced trivy-db sync across runners (will spike network for a minute). If we do that, GHAS should converge.
Alice M: I prefer disable auto-apply suppression until we add audit logging. Who owns the suppression PR that merged? @Ben J?
Ben J: That was mine — I merged last night to quiet a noisy low-sev false positive. I didn't realize it could flip back with DB changes. My bad.
Eve: Action items: 1) Disable suppression auto-apply (temporary) 2) Force trivy DB sync 3) Add suppression PR checklist (owner + justification + expiry) 4) Add audit log entry for suppression changes.
Charlie K: I'll open a short-lived PR to pin DB and add retry logic. Also will add a small GHAS workflow check that rejects suppression files missing an `owner:` field. Example check: 
```yaml
- name: Validate suppressions
  run: |
    jq -e '.owner' suppressions/*.yml || exit 1
```
Ben J: I'll revert the auto-apply change in the infra repo and add a note on the PR explaining the risk.
devsec-bot: Created issue #SEC-4287: "Suppression auto-apply causes flapping with trivy-db rotation" — assigned to Charlie K, severity: P3.
Alice M: Quick triage on the listed CVEs: CVE-2024-9999 (high) affects an internal library but has a backport available — we should prioritise a patch release (P2). CVE-2025-1111 (medium) is in a vendored optional dep, patch can wait one sprint (P4).
Eve: For compliance, we need a recorded justification if a suppression stays in place for >7 days. Add to the checklist.
SRE Oncall: I'm starting the trivy-db sync now. ETA ~3m. Will post when done.
SRE Oncall: trivy-db sync completed. Rerun GHAS job?
Alice M: Re-running job now.
devsec-bot: GHAS scan 2026-03-19_ghas_3321 re-run completed. Findings: 1 (CVE-2024-9999) — CVE-2025-1111 no longer reported.
Ben J: That looks stable. I'll hold off on any more suppression merges until we add validation + audit log.
Charlie K: Opening PRs: 1) pin DB + retry logic 2) suppression validation + owner check 3) audit logging for suppression changes (log to internal-seclogs KMS-encrypted bucket).
Eve: Please add the RBAC check — only infra:scanner-bot and sec-admins can merge suppression PRs. No unilateral merges.
Alice M: Thanks all. Let's track in SEC-4287 and do a retro next week to update runbooks. :thumbsup:
Eve: noted.
Ben J: sorry for the churn — will coordinate next time. :bow:
